description: Media tiers are reusable policy definitions; acquisition profiles specify upgrade target, maximum and minimum.

codes.note: Encoded 4K with unrestricted bitrate and file size; remux and full-disc exclusions still apply.

codecBudgetNote: Planning estimates, not a measurement of equal visual quality; exact video bitrate is unavailable from many release listings.
acquisitionSyntax: @ {upgrade target} | mx {highest accepted tier} | mn {lowest accepted tier}
constraints: A release above the target remains eligible when maximum allows it.
